answer_1.quote: Evaluation of conversational systems has been one major obstacle in dialogue research. Particularly for open-domain dialogues, automated metrics have been shown to correlate poorly with human judgement.

answer_2.quote: Examples of successful attempts to improve automated metrics include exploiting multiple references for comparison and combining human judgement with automated metrics.

answer_4.quote: we ask Amazon Mechanical Turk workers to rate response appropriateness on a 5-point Likert scale. Each pair is rated by four workers.
answer_4.guideline: rate response appropriateness on a 5-point Likert scale
